attestations.text: Lu Wên-shêng 陸文聲, a native of Soochow, memorialized the Emperor denouncing the Fu-shê as a corrupting and disturbing force in the nation. As a measure of defense Chang P'u proceeded to strengthen his organization by resorting to more direct activities of a political nature.
